content.text:
Start with a "camping out" approach: sit beside Milo's bed until he's drowsy, then move your chair a little farther toward the door each night over 1-2 weeks. At 5, he's ready for this kind of gradual independence - a small reward in the morning for staying in his own bed the whole night helps a lot too.

Want the full night-by-night plan? Reply YES and I'll send it.
